note: Ninety seconds, standing outside, often in weather. One story, the relationship, the closing line — and the same verbatim rule, because a graveside is not a place where a tidied-up quotation is any more acceptable.

response.openingLine: We won't keep you standing long. She wouldn't have.
body: The first thing I was ever told about Ruth was this: "{{memory:0}}" That was {{memoryFrom:0}}, and it was true for the whole time I knew her.
It was small things, done quietly, for years. That is what she leaves, and it is a great deal.
response.closingLine: Thank you for coming out here for her.
